0.name: TEXT_REGOTH3DOMANENCLAVE_00415_YOMOGI_000_000
0.description: It is you! The one who fought alongside Lord Hien and won Doma her freedom! It is an honor to receive you, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>!

4.name: TEXT_REGOTH3DOMANENCLAVE_00415_A1_000_102
4.description: What kind of place is this?

6.name: TEXT_REGOTH3DOMANENCLAVE_00415_YOMOGI_000_200
6.description: My name is Yomogi, and as for what I do... Well, when our family still had our stall, I helped my parents sell dango. But those days are gone...

7.name: TEXT_REGOTH3DOMANENCLAVE_00415_YOMOGI_000_201
7.description: The markets once rivaled those of Kugane. You could buy anything─even Hannish spices! It will take many years of hard work before it even begins to approach its former glory, but we will do what we must.

8.name: TEXT_REGOTH3DOMANENCLAVE_00415_YOMOGI_000_300
8.description: The enclave was once a center of culture and commerce. Merchants and artisans from all across Yanxia came here to live and work...but that all ended a year ago.

9.name: TEXT_REGOTH3DOMANENCLAVE_00415_YOMOGI_000_301
9.description: After crushing the rebellion, Zenos made an example of the enclave...and we who survived were forced to live in the ruins...

10.name: TEXT_REGOTH3DOMANENCLAVE_00415_YOMOGI_000_302
10.description: Monzen suffered a similar fate...though unlike the enclave, none were allowed to remain.

11.name: TEXT_REGOTH3DOMANENCLAVE_00415_YOMOGI_000_303
11.description: But those dark days are finally behind us! Now that our homeland has been freed from Garlean rule, we can begin rebuilding in earnest! Is it not wonderful?
